opportunities.title: Can a defect detector survive a change of lighting?

opportunities.question: Does threshold calibration or limited adaptation improve reliability under lighting shift at a fixed false-alarm budget?

opportunities.alternative: Frozen features + nearest-neighbour anomaly score; simple image statistics; an existing Anomalib baseline.
opportunities.proposed_difference: A controlled comparison of adaptation and calibration under predefined lighting shifts and label budgets—not a recreation of the benchmark.
opportunities.risk: Prior work may already answer the question; industrial images do not establish performance on a customer’s production line.
